about: A live run of T6-tip-calculator, recorded for replay.

features.name: Split bill
features.request: Split a bill of 87.50 between 4 friends

value.name: Bill splitter
value.summary: Splits a bill between friends with a tip. It starts with 87.50, 4 people and 15% tip, and you can change any of them.

value.interfacePart: Show what each person pays in bigger numbers.

features.name: Bigger payment numbers
features.request: Show what each person pays in bigger numbers

value.summary: The bill splitter now shows what each person pays in much bigger numbers, in a large highlighted block. Everything else works as before.

value.interfacePart: Add an option to round each share up to a whole number.

features.name: round shares up
features.request: round each share up to a whole number

value.summary: Bill splitter with a new checkbox to round each person's share up to a whole number. When it's on, the share is rounded up and the label says so.
